record.original_question: A system with multiplicative structure is a quadruple (X, X, µ, T_n) where T_0 = T_1 = id and T_m ◦ T_n = T_{mn}. In every such system and for every measurable set A of positive measure, do there exist integers m > n ≥ 1 such that µ(T_{2mn} A ∩ T_{(m-n)(m+n)} A) > 0?

evidence.quote: Problem 34. Let (X, X , µ, Tn) be a measure preserving system with multiplicative structure and A ∈ X with µ(A) > 0. Is it true that there exist m, n ∈ N, m > n, such that µ(T2mn A ∩ T(m−n)(m+n) A) > 0 ?

Let Tn, n ∈ Z, be invertible measure preserving transformations acting on a probability space (X, X , µ) that satisfy T0 = T1 = id and Tm ◦ Tn = Tmn for every m, n ∈ N. We say that the quadruple (X, X , µ, Tn) is a measure preserving system with multiplicative structure.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(X,\mathcal{X},\mu)$ be a probability space. Suppose $\{T_n\}_{n\in\mathbb{Z}}$ is a family of invertible measure-preserving transformations of $(X,\mathcal{X},\mu)$ satisfying
$$T_0 = T_1 = \mathrm{id}, \qquad T_m \circ T_n = T_{mn} \quad \text{for all } m,n\in\mathbb{N}.$$
We call $(X,\mathcal{X},\mu,\{T_n\})$ a measure-preserving system with multiplicative structure.

Prove or disprove: for every such system and for every $A\in\mathcal{X}$ with $\mu(A)>0$, there exist integers $m>n\geq 1$ such that
$$\mu\bigl(T_{2mn}\,A \;\cap\; T_{(m-n)(m+n)}\,A\bigr) > 0.$$

(The pair $(2mn,\,(m-n)(m+n))$ is the standard parametrization of the legs of a Pythagorean triple.)
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work by Frantzikinakis and collaborators (2023–2025) establishes recurrence along generalized Pythagorean triples for restricted classes of multiplicative measure-preserving actions (notably pretentious systems), and proves partition regularity of Pythagorean pairs, but the general multiplicative recurrence question for arbitrary multiplicative systems on Pythagorean configurations $(2mn,(m-n)(m+n))$ does not appear to be resolved. Surveys note that whether sets arising from Pythagorean triples are sets of multiplicative recurrence remains unknown.

status_evidence.title: Recurrence for pretentious systems along generalized Pythagorean triples
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes recurrence along generalized Pythagorean triples for pretentious multiplicative measure-preserving actions, a restricted subclass.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial results for special multiplicative systems; the general problem is not stated as resolved.

status_evidence.title: Partition regularity of Pythagorean pairs
status_evidence.snippet: Proves partition regularity of Pythagorean pairs via averaged multiplicative ergodic-type results.
status_evidence.claim: Recent advances treat related combinatorial problems but do not resolve the general multiplicative ergodic recurrence question.

status_evidence.title: Decomposition results for multiplicative actions and applications
status_evidence.snippet: Multiple recurrence for multiplicative actions with iterates given by products of linear forms in two variables, under additional structural hypotheses.
status_evidence.claim: Indicates the general recurrence question for multiplicative systems on Pythagorean-type pairs is still being approached and is not fully solved.
